info.title: API.SH: GoodFirms
info.description: The GoodFirms API from API.SH: public GoodFirms data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

get.description:
Every service directory on GoodFirms: name, path to pass as `category` to /goodfirms/v1/directory, URL, and for top-level directories the number of firms listed.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goodfirms-categories

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goodfirms-company

get.description:
Service providers listed in a GoodFirms directory (software, web, app, AI, marketing, design, IT and more), optionally by country, with the site's hourly-rate, team-size, client-type, service and industry filters and its sorts: name, profile and website links, logo, rating, review count, badges, hourly rate and price range, team size, founding year, location, description, AI tools used, the top review quote with the reviewer's role and why-choose-us points. Also returns the filter options (service and industry ids) and the country pages of the directory. Page with `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goodfirms-directory

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The directory path on goodfirms.co (see /goodfirms/v1/categories), e.g. directory/languages/top-software-development-companies, artificial-intelligence/generative-ai, companies/web-development-agency, or a full goodfirms.co URL.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country of the providers for directory/... categories: the site's code, e.g. us, gb, in, au, ca, de, fr, ae, or a name such as saudi-arabia.

parameters.name: employees
parameters.description: Team size band(s), separated by |: Freelancer, 2 - 9, 10 - 49, 50 - 249, 250 - 999, 1,000 - 9,999, 10000+.

parameters.name: client_type
parameters.description: Client focus, separated by |: small, midmarket, enterprise.

parameters.name: services
parameters.description: Service id(s) from `filters.services`, separated by |.

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Industry id(s) from `filters.industry`, separated by |.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: sponsored (the site's default), reviews (most reviews), rating (highly rated) or matrix (leaders matrix).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (1-based); `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

A company's verified client reviews on GoodFirms: title, overall and per-aspect ratings (quality, schedule and timing, communication), date, verification, services, full text, what the client liked and what could improve, and the project (name, description, cost band, industry, status). The reviewer's role and company are returned, never their name or contact details. Page with `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goodfirms-reviews

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
